limitations: The video shows multiple configurations, labelled separately, over the T2 plan.
Framing, titles and editing are film-only; all model, material and stage modules come from the frozen Site snapshot.
Photos inform selected finishes and components; cabinet lengths, room layout and equipment positioning are adapted to the T2 plan.
Colour verification measures encoding fidelity to rendered frames, not manufacturer colour accuracy.
Closed equipment fronts are shown; no claim of collision-free opening hardware.
